subject: Mathematics
title: Conic Sections
summary: Conic us point ka locus hai jiski fixed point (focus) se doori, fixed line (directrix) se doori ki e guna hai: e = 1 parabola, e < 1 ellipse, e > 1 hyperbola. e ko eccentricity kehte hain.
Standard forms: parabola y² = 4ax; ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 (b² = a²(1 − e²)); hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 (b² = a²(e² − 1)).
Har conic ke liye focus, directrix, latus rectum, eccentricity, parametric point, tangent aur normal ki equations aur tangent condition yaad rakho.

formulas.name: Parabola y² = 4ax
formulas.formula: focus (a, 0);  directrix x = −a;  axis y = 0;  latus rectum 4a;  parametric (at², 2at);  focal distance of (x, y) = x + a

formulas.name: Parabola tangents
formulas.formula: at (x₁, y₁): yy₁ = 2a(x + x₁);  slope form y = mx + a/m (condition c = a/m);  at t: ty = x + at²

formulas.name: Parabola normal
formulas.formula: y = mx − 2am − am³;  at t: y + tx = 2at + at³
formulas.mistake: Ek point se parabola par teen normals khinch sakte hain (m mein cubic) — sirf ek mat samjho.

formulas.name: Focal chord
formulas.formula: for focal chord through t₁ and t₂: t₁t₂ = −1;  harmonic mean of focal segments = semi-latus rectum 2a

formulas.name: Ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 (a > b)
formulas.formula: b² = a²(1 − e²);  foci (±ae, 0);  directrices x = ±a/e;  latus rectum 2b²/a;  parametric (a cos θ, b sin θ)

formulas.name: Ellipse focal property
formulas.formula: SP + S′P = 2a for any point P

formulas.name: Ellipse tangent
formulas.formula: at (x₁, y₁): xx₁/a² + yy₁/b² = 1;  y = mx ± √(a²m² + b²)

formulas.name: Hyperbola x²/a² − y²/b² = 1
formulas.formula: b² = a²(e² − 1);  foci (±ae, 0);  directrices x = ±a/e;  latus rectum 2b²/a;  asymptotes y = ±(b/a)x;  parametric (a sec θ, b tan θ)

formulas.name: Hyperbola tangent
formulas.formula: at (x₁, y₁): xx₁/a² − yy₁/b² = 1;  y = mx ± √(a²m² − b²)

formulas.name: Rectangular hyperbola
formulas.formula: x² − y² = a² (e = √2);  xy = c² with parametric (ct, c/t)

formulas.name: Director circle
formulas.formula: ellipse: x² + y² = a² + b²;  hyperbola: x² + y² = a² − b²;  parabola: directrix

examples.title: Parabola
examples.problem: y² = 12x ke liye a, focus aur latus rectum ki length nikalo.

examples.title: Ellipse
examples.problem: x²/25 + y²/16 = 1 ke liye e, foci aur latus rectum nikalo.

examples.title: Hyperbola
examples.problem: x²/16 − y²/9 = 1 ke liye e aur latus rectum nikalo.

examples.title: Focal distances ka sum
examples.problem: Ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1 ke kisi bhi point P ke liye SP + S′P nikalo.

examples.title: Tangent condition
examples.problem: c ki kis value par y = 2x + c, y² = 8x ko chhooti hai?

examples.title: Conic pehchaano
examples.solution: 36 se divide karo: x²/4 + y²/9 = 1 — ellipse jiska major axis y-axis ke saath hai (a = 3, b = 2), e = √5/3.

topics.title: Other forms of the parabola
topics.explain: x² = 4ay (upar khulta), y² = −4ax (left khulta), x² = −4ay (neeche khulta). Shifted: (y − k)² = 4a(x − h) ka vertex (h, k).

topics.title: Ellipse with vertical major axis
topics.explain: x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 mein b > a ho to a² = b²(1 − e²), foci (0, ±be) aur directrices y = ±b/e.

topics.title: Auxiliary circle and eccentric angle
topics.explain: Major axis ko diameter maan kar bana circle auxiliary circle x² + y² = a² hai; point (a cos θ, b sin θ) ka eccentric angle θ hai.

topics.title: Reflection property
topics.explain: Parabola ke axis ke parallel rays focus se reflect hoti hain (dish antennas, headlights). Ellipse ke ek focus se nikli rays doosre focus se reflect hoti hain.

topics.title: Chord of contact and midpoint chord
topics.explain: Circles jaisa notation: chord of contact T = 0; diye midpoint wali chord T = S₁.

topics.title: Identifying a general conic
topics.explain: ax² + 2hxy + by² + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0 (non-degenerate) ke liye: h² = ab parabola, h² < ab ellipse, h² > ab hyperbola; a + b = 0 rectangular hyperbola.

ratta: y² = 4ax: focus (a, 0), LR 4a, focal distance x + a.
Tangent conditions: parabola c = a/m;  ellipse c² = a²m² + b²;  hyperbola c² = a²m² − b².
Ellipse b² = a²(1 − e²);  hyperbola b² = a²(e² − 1).
